Name: (CP) Shop Mini-Fridge From Begin
Author: MaximillianRW
Description:
As the brief overview says, this mod changes the condition to Robin sell you the Mini-Fridge, making it available from the first day on the game. No more need to have a kitchen to buy a Mini-Fridge.

Specially made to the people that wants to live in a shack with a Mini-Fridge.

Very recommended to use with mods that makes Mini-Fridges more useful or necessary, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14712]aedenthorn's Spoilage[/url]﻿. (To which there is an unnoficial update to 1.6 [url=http://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/post-142758]here[/url].)

My very first Stardew Valley mod here, so let me know if changes need to be made.

Enjoy.

Manifest.Name: ShopMiniFridgeFromBegin
Manifest.Description: Makes Mini-Fridge available on Robin's Carpenter Shop from the first day.
